subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，Tetrahydrofuran-2-yl radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: An α-oxy radical, among the most nucleophilic radicals known. Cl• or decatungstate hydrogen-atom transfer makes it from THF, and it adds to electron-poor alkenes or to nickel.
